description: This file defines a JavaScript function for handling form submission related to campaign prospect list management in a CRM interface. It interacts directly with HTML forms, setting form field values and submitting the form to relate campaigns with prospects.
external_files: form elements, potentially part of the CRM application's pages

methods.name: set_return_prospect_list_and_save(popup_reply_data)
